test.create_query: CREATE TABLE materialized_cte_small (k UInt64, v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO materialized_cte_small SELECT number, number * 3 FROM numbers(100)

query.tag: filter, then GROUP BY with 1M keys

test.query: WITH t AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT number % 1000003 AS k, number AS v FROM numbers_mt(100000000)) SELECT count(), sum(s) FROM (SELECT k, sum(v) AS s FROM t WHERE v % 3 = 0 GROUP BY k) WHERE k IN (SELECT k FROM t WHERE v % 1000 = 0)

WITH t AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT number % 1000003 AS k, number AS v FROM numbers_mt(100000000)), d AS (SELECT number AS k, number % 7 AS g FROM numbers(50000)) SELECT g, count(), sum(v) FROM t INNER JOIN d USING (k) WHERE k IN (SELECT k FROM t WHERE v % 1000 = 0) GROUP BY g ORDER BY g FORMAT Null

query.tag: LIKE filter on a String column

test.query: WITH t AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT number % 1000003 AS k, number AS v, toString(number) AS s FROM numbers_mt(100000000)) SELECT count(), sum(length(s)) FROM t WHERE s LIKE '%77%' AND k IN (SELECT k FROM t WHERE v % 1000 = 0)
WITH t AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT k, v FROM materialized_cte_small) SELECT count(), sum(v) FROM t WHERE k IN (SELECT k FROM t WHERE v % 2 = 0)
